findings: Identity leak in markAllNotificationsRead — The method embeds role, userId, and email from the stored user into the PATCH /api/v1/notifications/read-all body; the backend derives identity from the JWT and ignores these fields. Remove the getStoredUser() call and send an empty body {}.

Unauthenticated cold-launch navigation — getInitialMessage fires handleNotificationNavigation after a 1200ms delay with no session check. On a logged-out device this pushes NotificationScreen, which receives a 401 and silently calls clearSession(). Add a getStoredToken() null-check before navigating, or handle 401 inside NotificationScreen by redirecting to login.

Colors.transparent not an AppColors token — _buildNotificationTile uses Colors.transparent as the background for read tiles (line 270). The task requires AppColors.of(context) throughout. Replace with themeColors.cardSurface.
